description: Chasecall hooks. On session start, quietly show what is overdue. Before any Bash or PowerShell command, stop anything irreversible - sending, paying, deleting, cancelling - unless the user approved it in the last 15 minutes. Reading is never blocked. Every hook goes through the step 0 guard - hooks/python.sh in sh and Git Bash, hooks/python.ps1 in PowerShell (Windows without Git Bash): it runs only with a real Python 3 and otherwise does nothing - no Apple install window mid-lesson on a Mac without Command Line Tools, no Microsoft Store stub on Windows; the session start says so in one line.

hooks.command:
exec sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/python.sh" chasecall say "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/tracker.py" due --brief
& ([scriptblock]::Create((Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/python.ps1"))) chasecall say "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/tracker.py" due --brief

exec sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/python.sh" chasecall quiet "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/guard.py"
& ([scriptblock]::Create((Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/python.ps1"))) chasecall quiet "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/guard.py"
